text:
maria: Heads-up — SCIM provisioning to prod is failing for a new SSO tenant after an RBAC rollback, getting 403 from the idp-proxy.
sam: Which tenant and any error snippets?
maria: tenant acme-inc. Logs show `403 Forbidden - missing_entitlement` from scim-service. snippet: ```POST /scim/v2/Users 403 {"error":"missing_entitlement","detail":"rbac:tenant:acme-inc:scim_provision"}```
alex: Did we rotate KMS keys last night? The entitlement tokens are HMAC-signed by our KMS-backed signer.
maria: Yes, KMS rotation happened 2026-03-22 (roll-id=rot-2026-03-22). We expected alias mappings to be stable but I see an alias mismatch in the key service IAM mapping.
sam: @security FYI — looks like RBAC role mapping got reverted during the canary rollback which would remove the provisioning entitlement binding. @oncall can you confirm the rollback details?
oncall: Confirmed — rollback at 02:10 removed commit 8a7f3c which had rbac:scim-provision grants for a subset of tenants. Reapplying now.
maria: Reapplying RBAC grants didn't fix it. Still 403. Audit logs now show `signature_verification_failed` for service-account `scim-agent@acme-inc`. Here is the audit snippet: ```{"time":"2026-03-22T02:37:12Z","svc":"scim-service","msg":"jwt_verify_failed","kid":"alias/scim-signer-rot-2026","principal":"scim-agent@acme-inc","err":"invalid signature"}```
alex: If signature verification failed, the kid/header might point to a rotated alias that our verifier doesn't map to the correct key id. Check `x-kid` in the token header vs current alias->key mapping.
maria: Token header shows kid=alias/scim-signer-rot-2026, but our key service resolves alias/scim-signer to key-id=arn:aws:kms:...:key/aaaa which no longer matches the kid in the token.
sam: Short-term mitigation: enable `legacy_kid_fallback=true` in scim-service config to accept previous alias mappings and bump rollout to 50% until we finish a proper reissue. Note: this is a risk window.
security: Don't enable fallback long-term. Plan: rotate scim-agent certs and reissue tokens signed with the new key, update audit log annotations to capture KMS alias used, and create a vuln ticket for ambiguous alias mapping during KMS rotation.
maria: I've created the ticket INFSEC-1234 with logs and repro steps: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFSEC-1234. I'll reissue tokens now.
alex: Reissue command (prod): ```kubectl -n prod exec -it deploy/scim-agent -- /app/tools/generate_token --service=scim-agent --kid=alias/scim-signer``` then rollout restart the scim-agent deployment: `kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/scim-agent`.
maria: Running the commands now, restarting pods... :spinner:
deploy-bot: scim-agent/prod restart started by maria (pod/scim-agent-12ab). ETA ~45s
maria: Pods are back up. I retried provisioning for acme-inc and it succeeded.
sam: Running smoke across tenants now. All tenants are reporting successful provisioning. :white_check_mark:
security: Follow-ups — add a pre-rotate test that verifies alias->kid parity across services, add an audit hook that emits alerts on KMS alias changes, and add a runbook entry for RBAC+KMS coordinated rollbacks. I'll draft the runbook PR.
maria: Thanks everyone. Marking thread resolved and linking the postmortem once I finish the ticket write-up.
